items.name: dsh-dream-skin

items.name: dsh-catppuccin-theme

items.name: dsh-any-background

Rotate a pool of images (shuffle/order, every refresh/daily/weekly). Also: PS-style color wheel, one-click wallpaper color extraction, 6 presets + saved profiles, day/night auto switch, and full theme export/import.

items.name: dsh-wallpaper-engine

Plays local Wallpaper Engine Video/Web wallpapers behind the chat, renders Scene wallpapers as extracted static frames, and adds content-rating/type filters, custom uploads and an iOS-style liquid-glass settings window.

The 23 audio files are a header strip away from working OGG; the 357 images use proprietary .mzp/.cbg formats, so the per-file mapping guide offers two routes and one of them expects you to supply your own decoder.

items.desc: An F1 Race Control theme for DSH Web with four switchable team skins, broadcast-photo backgrounds, light and dark modes, and native appearance controls.

items.name: dsh-theme-inkstone
items.desc: Inkstone is a monochrome theme inspired by Obsidian Minimal E-ink, with inverted sidebar interactions, colored Markdown headings and locally installed LXGW WenKai font fallbacks; it preserves native font and appearance preferences and targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.

items.name: dsh-za-warudo
items.desc: Adds an Appearance switch to the DSH sidebar with a three-second time-stop transition, synchronized sound, and light/dark theme switching.

items.name: rhine-lab-codex-theme#dsh
items.desc: Rhine Lab-inspired light and dark themes with animated backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-wallpaper
items.desc: Local images and videos as the DSH desktop window background: timed rotation with 0.7s cross-fades, first-frame-ready before fading in, automatic light/dark ink for readability, adjustable blur and panel/sidebar opacity, video thumbnails, and a probe endpoint reporting load, layer and selector health. Reads only the local files you point it at.

items.name: dsh-theme-frost
items.desc: Turns an image folder into a frosted-glass global wallpaper for the DSH web UI, keeping the official palette.

items.name: dsh-cutesnowgirl-background
items.desc: Adds a muted looping video behind the Harness workspace and makes the composer translucent after the boot splash finishes.

items.name: deepseek-harness-background
items.desc: Custom background image for the DSH Web UI: upload a picture or paste an image URL behind the whole app surface, with opacity, theme-aware scrim, panel transparency, frosted-glass and wallpaper blur, live preview and persisted settings, plus an optional DeepSeek-style timeline rail with per-question bookmarks for long conversations.

items.name: dsh-background-by-model
items.desc: Per-model appearance for the DSH Web UI: an ordered rule list matched against the current session model name, each rule carrying its own wallpaper, theme colour, layout mode, framing and wallpaper opacity and blur, plus per-surface opacity and frosted-glass blur for the main background, left panel, right panel, cards and panels, input and controls, settings panel, conversation text frame and trajectory view.

items.name: dsh-entry-transition
items.desc: One-shot entrance animation when the workspace opens: the logo is written onto the canvas, then an inverted color bar sweeps across on exit; mirrors light/dark themes automatically.

items.name: hcguo-public#amber-forge
items.desc: Amber CRT-style skin for DeepSeek Harness: overrides 14 theme tokens and 23 static palette entries, forces a monospace font stack everywhere outside KaTeX math, adds scanlines and a screen vignette, replaces the brand emblem with an inner SVG gear-and-skull mark whose corners are transparent, rewrites the new-session slogan, and raises the agent-preset selector width by 10%.

items.name: dsh-theme-herta
items.desc: A Herta theme for DeepSeek Harness: an ASCII boot opening ported from the upstream Herta project, a violet palette of design tokens, swappable wallpapers (four bundled, plus image URL, local import, solid colour or off) and a "Herta Appearance" page in DSH settings. Doubles as the theme that dsh-herta ships with.

items.name: deepseek-whale-wallpaper
items.desc: Live dot-matrix whale wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: ~1,750 breathing WebGL2 particles with pointer liquid vortices, light/dark themes, and a Canvas2D fallback.

items.name: dsh-orca-glass
items.desc: DSH Web plugin that injects an SVG (feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap) refraction filter and applies it through backdrop-filter to panels, bubbles and the input card, and bundles the orca-scene skin with theme tokens plus light and dark backgrounds.

items.name: hwfee-dsh#cds-theme
items.desc: Claude Design System theme for DeepSeek Harness — remaps the host's tokens onto CDS warm-grey surfaces and the clay accent, and refines the composer, sidebar, message rows, code blocks and markdown body.

items.name: dsh-skins
items.desc: Hot-switchable brand skins for the DSH Web UI: an OpenBMC skin, a UEFI skin and an unofficial fan-made skin based on A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, each with light/dark schemes, plus a personal wallpaper gallery, per-skin tagline and transparency controls, and a one-click path back to the official look.

items.name: dsh-ui-liquid-glass
items.desc: DSH full liquid-glass skin: 13 adjustable refractive glass surfaces, time-of-day wallpapers, four theme colours and a water-drop style selection lens.

items.name: dsh-theme-blackhole
items.desc: A black hole theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI.

items.name: dsh-inkscreen-theme
items.desc: Ink-and-paper Apple-inspired theme for the DSH web client with a handwritten jimmy sidebar brand.

items.name: xiao-theme-dsh-ui-plugin
items.desc: A fully customizable theming framework for DSH UI, with Xiao from Genshin Impact as the default theme.

items.name: dsh-huashu-pixel
items.desc: Warm pixel theme for the DSH Web UI: cream-paper and arcade-phosphor palettes, hard-edged pixel chrome with bundled pixel fonts, CRT motion on streaming and state changes, three intensity tiers, and a pixel loading bar while a turn runs.

items.name: dsh-official-homepage-theme
items.desc: A web theme recreating the DeepSeek Harness homepage with a fluid background, an elastic pointer grid, animated fish, and adjustable effects.

items.name: ocean-wave-theme
items.desc: Animated ocean waves with a whale swimming behind the page, plus translucent surfaces.

items.name: dsh-bg-carousel
items.desc: Rotates images and videos from a media folder as the DSH UI background, with panel controls for the rotation interval and UI opacity.

items.name: dsh-firefly-spring-skin
items.desc: Firefly "Spring Missive" theme skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Overrides 74 --dsw-alias-* design tokens in matched light and dark sets, draws a spring-window backdrop with drifting petals and fireflies, places one character illustration on each side of the layout, and keeps the centre column legible with a radial spotlight scrim. Registers a Settings section with switches for the skin and for the artwork; both choices persist in localStorage.

items.name: dsh-nekojishi-vn
items.desc: Visual-novel theme with responsive characters, task-state expressions, role skills and a music player, including an original demo pack and optional local game imports.

items.name: dsh-ui-appearance
items.desc: A customized fork of TQSY114514/dsh-ui-appearance for theme palettes, wallpapers, and glassmorphism, with a layout fix for duplicate blank space alongside better-sidebar 0.18.0.

items.name: dsh-whale-particles-bg
items.desc: Animated whale background for the DSH Web UI: a particle field sampled from the whale silhouette plus a dot-grid layer, both full-screen click-through canvases mounted in the shell.overlay seat; the particles gather on load, breathe when idle and are pushed away from the pointer, the grid dots swell near it, and the palette follows the page light/dark theme.

items.name: dsh-skin-studio
items.desc: Local semantic-token theme editor with palette extraction, WCAG auditing, preview, and export.

items.name: dsh-raiden-theme
items.desc: Violet-gold acrylic DSH Web theme with light and dark stage art, framed chat, workspace mascot, and an optional Raiden agent preset.

items.name: dsh-taffy-theme
items.desc: Candy-pink acrylic DSH Web theme with light conservatory and dark stage art, gold-pink chat frame, Taffy character overlays, and an optional agent preset.

items.name: dsh-wallpaper-rotator#wallpaper-rotator
items.desc: Rotates the DSH app background wallpaper from a folder on a timer with cross-fade transitions; falls back to four bundled SVG gradients when no folder is set, and adds background-opacity, wallpaper-dimming, blur and text-shadow controls so panels and text stay readable.

items.name: deepseek-style-theme
items.desc: DeepSeek homepage-style theme skin for the dsh web GUI: fluid particle background, glass sidebar and composer, running-subagent progress panel, and DSTT peak-hour color modes.

items.name: dsh-any-background-plus
items.desc: An enhanced fork of dsh-any-background. Its own work, from v0.4.0 onward, adds a dual-lane wallpaper: the same picture down each side of the window, split at the exact centre so the wallpaper stays visible beside the conversation column. Each lane can also read its own folder (one directory per side) while sharing a single rotation cadence and mode, and both lanes take identical edge feathering.

items.name: dsh-skin-win2000
items.desc: Windows 2000 desktop skin for the DSH Web GUI: metric-accurate grey chrome, two-tone gradient title bars, 1px bevels, square corners, 16px scrollbars, and the pixel font it renders with served by its own host route.

items.name: ds-hentai
items.desc: ExHentai.org-inspired UI for DeepSeek Harness. DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai. Charcoal background, light-gray text, gray borders. The session list reads like a gallery index; the composer reads like a search bar. Live Demo: https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/

items.name: dsh-qq-skin
items.desc: A QQ NT messenger skin for DeepSeek Harness: light and dark share one QQ NT language — clean restrained light mode (brand blue #12B7F5, light-blue bubbles) and a calm blue-gray dark mode (#101822) — applied as reversible token and layout layers that never touch your Light/Dark preference.

items.name: dsh-skin-liquid-glass
items.desc: iOS 26 liquid-glass skin: one white-grey-blue fog field behind the whole window, a single 40px frost on top of it, a floating glass sidebar and reply bubbles. Light and dark palettes, no photo wallpaper, no dependencies (33 KB).

items.name: dsh-jcc-theme
items.desc: Unofficial Golden Spatula fan theme for the DSH Web GUI: an original hextech arena backdrop with a golden spatula crest (a parchment chart in light mode), four accent palettes (gold, cyan, violet, blue), a hex-board lattice, an optional aurora-and-gold-dust ambience, soft or sharp corners, and a floating hex-core panel that can turn the theme off without uninstalling.

items.name: dsh-theme-windowsxp
items.desc: Windows XP (Luna) skin for the DSH web GUI: beige Luna panels, gradient buttons, #7F9DB9 input fields, rounded blue scrollbars and a CSS-drawn Bliss-style desktop, plus a chime when a turn finishes and a different cue when the agent stops for approval.

items.name: dsh-skin-pixel-anime
items.desc: Pixel Dynamic Starfield theme: five palettes, four layered text schemes, five pixel fonts including a simplified-Chinese face, square or rounded corners, a rotating pixel starfield with meteors, and a header pixel clock — configured from its own settings tab.

items.name: dsh-endfield-theme
items.desc: Arknights: Endfield theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: charcoal and hazard-yellow industrial HUD, a boot splash injected ahead of the shell, a conversation backdrop, and a re-cut Windows title bar. Restyles the sidebar brand to 终末地工业 / ENDFIELD INDUSTRIES, which a URL flag reverts.

items.name: dsh-effort-ultra-skin
items.desc: A CSS skin that restyles the reasoning-tier control drawn by hytime/dsh-thinking-effort into a blue-to-violet pill with a starfield and a sheen sweep, with matching light and dark palettes. Requires that plugin to be installed; it adds no UI of its own.

items.name: dsh-workbench-theme
items.desc: Light/dark colour theme for the DSH web UI with an APTX capsule logo, browser tab title and icon branding, and optional Ai Haibara (Detective Conan) artwork panels, configured under Settings → General → Appearance with a no-decoration mode.

items.name: dsh-whale-decor
items.desc: Deep-sea whale-blue reskin for the DSH Web GUI: 14 theme tokens in light and dark, five whale-tail-maid placements, a clock and weather card, and a collapsible hardware readout (CPU, memory, GPU, per-drive temperatures via HWiNFO). No backdrop image is bundled; drop your own in. MIT code, MIT character art.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-kitty
items.desc: Hello Kitty pink theme skin for the DSH Web UI: overrides the --dsw-alias-* semantic tokens in light and dark mode and paints a custom wallpaper on the app frame. Installs as a static profile plugin, so the theme restores automatically on every Harness start.

items.name: dsh-skin-rotation
items.desc: Picks a random installed skin on every DeepSeek Harness launch and enables exactly that skin, with an on/off switch and a shuffle action inside the Skins settings page. Skins the running host would refuse to load are excluded, and a manual switch still applies until the next launch.

items.name: dsh-appearance
items.desc: A lightweight font and theme plugin for the DSH client: Latin/Chinese/code font pickers that list only installed families, and five official palettes (One Dark Pro, Dracula, Nord, GitHub, Catppuccin) applied through the official theme tokens, including code-block syntax colors. No bundled fonts, no dependencies, no build step. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.

items.name: dsh-theme-customizer
items.desc: Visual theme customizer for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — backgrounds, text colors, borders and details, all adjustable visually, with presets you can import and export, persisted across restarts.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-mc-skin
items.desc: Minecraft-styled skin for the DSH Web client: MC GUI palette and pixel bevels, a pixel logo, on/off switch art, two persistent toggles in Settings, and an optional 16 MB Minecraft AE pixel font served on demand by the host half.

items.name: dsh-skin-background
items.desc: Image-background skin with four shipped wallpapers, a user wallpaper directory, custom image URLs, and live dim/blur controls in Settings.

items.name: dsh-markdown-xyy
items.desc: Lightweight Markdown conversation theme plugin — enhances native color scheme with 4 built-in themes (light/dark dual), user-defined CSS themes, system-aware auto-switching, in-browser theme editor, designed to enhance reading speed and clarity.

items.name: dsh-theme-presets
items.desc: Adds Nord, Dracula, Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, One Dark, Gruvbox, Solarized, GitHub, Everforest, Kanagawa and Rosé Pine presets to the DSH Web GUI theme picker, layered over the built-in light/dark/system appearance.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-tianlight
items.desc: Tianlight skin for DeepSeek Harness: 4K video/image wallpapers, local upload and auto-rotation, optional WebWallGL scenes, liquid glass, and a Mint cat companion. Alt+W opens the wallpaper panel.

items.name: dsh-hu-tao-skin
items.desc: A Genshin Impact Hu Tao (Wangsheng Funeral Parlor) skin for the dsh web GUI - a 14-token ink-black, crimson and amber palette, falling plum petals and spirit butterflies, a plum-blossom brand mark, and a floating petal toggle that tracks the sidebar.

items.name: dsh-darksoft-theme
items.desc: Dark theme plugin for dsh web (port of Obsidian things-soft-colorful-headings): warm-gray dimmed text via --dsw-alias-label-* token overrides plus soft colorful h1-h6 headings, zero dependencies.

items.name: dsh-nico-theme
items.desc: Switchable liquid-glass theme for the DSH web UI — 14 panels become frosted glass over a fluid backdrop, with material sliders and hover elasticity.

items.name: dsh-yorha-ui
items.desc: A NieR:Automata / YoRHa-inspired industrial terminal theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with sand-and-charcoal palettes, square geometry, and interface-wide styling.

items.name: dsh-ui-liteglass
items.desc: A lightweight appearance skin for DeepSeek Harness: custom wallpaper, glass-like panel transparency, and an accent color; server-side settings shared across devices, native light/dark mode left untouched.

items.name: prts · 源石协议
items.desc: Arknights PRTS Originium Protocol theme featuring interactive 3D crystal, tactical HUD, memory fragments, and boot sequence.

items.name: dsh-starry-sky-theme
items.desc: Dark-only starry-sky theme for the Web UI: both Light and Dark resolve to one deep-space night palette with a twinkling click-through starfield and four constellation figures, and the appearance preference is pinned to Dark while the plugin is enabled.

items.name: dsh-sky-window#dsh-sky-window
items.desc: Adds a city-local sky theme with a moving sun, day and night colors, drifting clouds, time previews, and an immersive sky view to the DSH web workspace.

items.name: gord-dsh-saber-theme
items.desc: Saber (Fate) theme for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web with light/dark palettes, 30 on-demand chat wallpapers rotating every five minutes, and a task attention tray below the right-side turn index, compatible with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2.

items.name: dsh-wallpaper-bg
items.desc: Standalone wallpaper background for the DSH Web UI and desktop app: built-in wallpapers, local image/video uploads stored in IndexedDB, and a read-only local Wallpaper Engine library served by the bundled wallpaper-engine-api service in the repository; renders images, video and scene workshop previews, with light-fog/dark-overlay, blur, brightness and safe-zoom controls plus a read-only follow-desktop-wallpaper mode.

items.name: dsh-claude-style
items.desc: Claude Code Desktop look-and-feel for the DSH Web GUI — ivory/warm-black dual canvas, clay accent, three-font typography, permission segmented control and brand switcher, via CSS overrides and client DOM overrides.

items.name: dsh-edex-xry-ui#bundle
items.desc: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI themed as an XRY/B1 medical HUD: ECG heartbeat waveform and a rotating radar scan disc on the right bar, power-gen energy-cell meters on the left bar, a DATA TIMELINE scan-log table on the bottom, all in a cyan-on-near-black CRT skin around the original UI.

items.name: dsh-liquid-glass-studio
items.desc: iOS 26 style liquid glass theme for DeepSeek Harness: a fully transparent workspace, layered glass panels, a built-in wallpaper gallery, and a control center for workspaces and plugins.

items.name: dsh-bluefatfish
items.desc: Deep-sea skin for the DSH Web UI: an 80-token light/dark theme layer, a two-layer background, a gradient sidebar with a whale sticker, a wordmark that doubles as the skin switch, and a rotating turn-status line.

items.name: dsh-wechat-classic-theme
items.desc: WeChat-style light theme with a dark icon rail, grey conversation list and green chat bubbles.

items.name: dsh-sky-skin
items.desc: Sky: Children of the Light skin for the dsh web UI - light children on a glowing star map, candlelight gold and starry night.

items.name: dsh-theme-kami
items.desc: Kami-inspired editorial skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with a warm parchment canvas, ink-blue accent, serif typography and hairline borders in light and dark palettes.

items.name: dsh-client-theme-cyber
items.desc: Dark navy glass theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with a cyber-city background and holographic-cube cyan accents.

items.name: codex-ui
items.desc: Codex-style appearance for the DSH Web interface: window edge hairlines and shadows, sidebar colours and row alignment, a model picker with a reasoning-effort power rail, composer and right-panel geometry, a full-page settings-modal pass, a Trajectory view exit, and a settings card for theme, accent, background, foreground, fonts, sidebar translucency and contrast.

items.name: dsh-colorlab
items.desc: Colour engine for the chat UI: ships the Mariana palette as the default preset, exposes 18 colour slots and 9 Markdown prose roles, lets you save up to 12 presets, and colours LaTeX blocks by running Sublime's own LaTeX syntax.

items.name: dsh-theme-manager
items.desc: Two-level theme manager for the DSH Web UI: pick a culture / scene, a national flag, a developer palette, or a high-contrast pairing first, then a concrete style (58 built-in palettes, light and dark).

items.name: dsh-xingkong-theme
items.desc: Deep-space theme for the Harness Web GUI: two fully designed light and dark palettes over a seamless cross-dissolve nebula wallpaper, plus a model probe that reports which configured models actually answer and their real context window.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-verdandi
items.desc: An Aether Gazer Verdandi-inspired DSH Web UI skin with light and dark backgrounds, wedding-themed chrome, responsive character art, and themed conversation and sidebar surfaces.

items.name: dsh-theme-tuner
items.desc: Add a theme-adjustment panel under Appearance to customize accent, background, foreground, contrast and gradient, applied live through theme token overrides.

items.name: dsh-theme-liuguang#liuguang
items.desc: Two switchable design languages for the DSH GUI — liquid glass with inner-lit surfaces and pointer specular, and Soviet constructivism with cream/ink/red poster geometry — plus a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs, and a seven-expression whale-girl pet.

items.name: dsh-theme-escook
items.desc: Signature escook theme ported from VS Code: 4 classic aesthetic color schemes (Dark, Dark Soft, Light, Light Soft) with high-contrast syntax highlighting for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-deep-diving
items.desc: Adds selectable animated skins to the "Deep diving..." status row, with configurable size and optional status-text replacement.

items.name: dsh-custom-skin
items.desc: Browser-local wallpaper and translucent-panel controls for DSH Web, with multiple images, fit and position choices, shading, blur, and panel opacity.

items.name: harness-plugin
items.desc: Adds two switchable themes, built-in and local-folder background slideshows, and per-session token usage details to DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop.

items.name: dsh-skin-lab
items.desc: Skin author workbench: official token browser (169 --dsw-* variables with Chinese descriptions and module-usage tags), live try-on, durable skin save, theme freeze, seven spectrum presets with SVG backdrops and custom backdrop upload.

items.name: dsh-vae-theme
items.desc: An ink-wash theme for DeepSeek Harness inspired by Luzhou Moon, a guofeng song by the Chinese singer Vae. Built on dsh-theme-customizer, it repaints the app background, sidebar, composer, new-session button, settings panel, Cordis panel and floating panel with generated ink-landscape artwork, adds gold filigree frames and a full-screen rain effect, and rotates vertical lyrics drawn from 24 of his Chinese-style songs.

items.name: dsh-kaze-tachinu-theme
items.desc: Kaze Tachinu (The Wind Rises) skin for the DSH Web GUI: a full-screen film wallpaper behind glassmorphism surfaces, sky-blue interaction tokens, redrawn vector logos for the sidebar and home hero, a restyled composer card with themed placeholder text, and a bottom fade on the message list.

items.name: claude-style-skin
items.desc: Claude-style warm-editorial skin for the DSH web GUI — ivory/warm-black canvas, a clay ember accent, serif display + sans UI + mono labels, hairline borders and pill CTAs, light/dark themes.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-qingxiao
items.desc: Qingxiao (Wuthering Waves) themed skin for the DSH web GUI, with ice-blue/jade/moon-white palette, sword-light motes and user-swappable backgrounds.

items.name: dsh-minecraft-ui
items.desc: Presents DSH Web as a playable, full-screen first-person Minecraft-style voxel interface—not a color-only skin: users walk through a persistent Three.js block world and access native workspaces, sessions, conversations, tools, model selection, permissions, context information, and the composer through in-world facilities and a workbench.

items.name: dsh-arknights-theme
items.desc: Arknights theme for the DSH Web GUI: twelve full-screen wallpapers whose edge blur, feathering and glass opacity are computed per image; ink solved in OKLCH to hold WCAG AA; Rhodes Island iconography throughout; and approval and question cards signed with operator autographs.

items.name: dsh-homepage-glass
items.desc: Fixed deep-blue gradient sidebar for the DSH Web UI plus three light-mode content backdrops (native white, a flowing blue WebGL shader ported from the deepseek.com homepage, or a muted blue), and brand-blue token overrides.

items.name: dsh-harness-os#dsh-harness-os
items.desc: Main UI skin that extends the dsh-startup-screen archive layout to the whole workspace, picking up from the boot animation when it hands off.

items.name: dsh-skin-switcher
items.desc: Skin switcher for the dsh web UI: one-click theme switching with auto-discovery of community skins.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-theme-studio
items.desc: Client theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: a fluid background, frosted glass panels and quantised shader effects, with 100 adjustable parameters persisted to a JSON file.

items.name: dsh-custom-font
items.desc: Customize the interface font, size, weight, color and layout from the settings page, Word-style and WYSIWYG, auto-saved. Ships two bundled open-source fonts (STIX2Text, Latin Modern Mono Light) plus an author-recommended typography, and stores settings under ~/.dsh.

items.name: dsh-xia-plugins#packages/client-game-assistant
items.desc: Sakura theme, companion notifications (approval/job/answer), message read-aloud, and voice settings for the DSH web GUI.

items.name: dsh-theme-taojian
items.desc: Taojian (陶笺): Claude-inspired DSH theme with warm paper, clay accent, Noto Serif SC, and Cascadia Mono.

items.name: dsh-scenery
items.desc: Capy-style ambient background for DSH with wallpaper, bottom black gradient, and composer aura.

items.name: dsh_genshin_nicole_skin
items.desc: Genshin Nicole PV wallpaper skin for the DSH web GUI — 14 subtitle-free frames rotate on a timed crossfade queue with pause and manual switching.

items.name: eva-inspired-theme
items.desc: A Neon Genesis Evangelion-inspired skin for DeepSeek Harness: Title Card (light) and Central Dogma (dark) modes over one removable override layer, 55 measured color tokens, a wallpaper paint layer whose two surface alphas are solved against a WCAG contrast budget, a boot mask and a brand mark. It also rewrites the sidebar identity line, replaces the new-session heading, hides six official entries, and reshapes the composer control row. Unofficial fan work, non-commercial: the background pictures are fetched from third-party URLs at paint time, not shipped in the repository.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-appearance-gallery
items.desc: Fifteen curated theme families and nine complete dsh-web-ui skin replicas in one plugin behind a single settings entry, with CSS-only custom theme JSON, controlled custom skin-pack import via folder picker, preview, apply, delete and restore-default. Ships on npm as `dsh-appearance-gallery`.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-theme-black-hole
items.desc: A switchable WebGPU black-hole theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that retains the built-in Dark palette and animates only the new-session background.

items.name: dsh-kinich-theme
items.desc: Kinich and Ajaw theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with three visual styles, session-state feedback, companion interactions, and configurable ambient effects.

items.name: dsh-xiao-theme
items.desc: Xiao character theme for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop with light and dark palettes, selectable illustrations, a draggable companion, session-state feedback, and optional official DeepSeek balance display.

items.name: dsh-theme-eye-care
items.desc: Three switchable low-glare themes (Warm Paper, Sage Green, Warm Grey) for the DeepSeek Harness GUI, each a full alias-token layer with a light and a dark face.

items.name: dsh-outerwilds-theme
items.desc: Outer Wilds theme with a static starfield, campfire effects, appearance settings, and bundled Jost and Source Han Sans fonts.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-seaglass
items.desc: Seaglass is a highly customizable glassmorphism theme.

items.name: deepseek-colorful
items.desc: UI theme customizer, acrylic frosted glass, and panoramic live video/wallpapers for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-skin-im2005
items.desc: 2005-era instant-messenger skin for the DeepSeek Harness client: right-angle 1px window chrome, a blue-gradient title bar, SimSun for the Chinese UI, a buddy-group sidebar with an avatar card and editable signature, per-message name/time headers, and three switchable intensities. All artwork is original SVG; the reskinned toolbar also carries a cross-session notepad, a running-session panel, and an 8-ball game, minesweeper, a token garden and heads-up poker that a built-in focus mode silences.

items.name: dsh-theme-songgrid
items.desc: Song-dynasty-inspired theme for the DSH web UI: a light "rice paper" and a dark "night ink" variant, Ru celadon carrying interactive states while kiln copper is reserved for blockquotes, plus a 4pt spacing scale and a 46-glyph mask icon set.

items.name: dsh-chat-background
items.desc: Chat wallpaper: use a local image, a local video or one of six preset gradients as the chat background, with clarity, opacity, zoom, position, dark veil, fit mode, motion and glass panels; files stay in IndexedDB and nothing is uploaded.

items.name: dsh-local-background
items.desc: Local-folder wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: it defaults to your Pictures library (C:\Users\<you>\Pictures) and the host serves those images over same-origin HTTP, rotating one every N minutes (0-1440, default 5) in a shuffled pass with no repeats; the settings page under Plugins picks a different folder through the native system dialog, and tunes image opacity (100%), darkening scrim (25%) and panel opacity (15%) with changes applied live. Dialogs, modals and menus keep the default opaque background so text stays readable. Reads .jpg .jpeg .png .webp .gif .avif .bmp straight from disk, and keeps per-user settings under $DSH_HOME so upgrades never ship your folder path.

items.name: deepseek-harness-plugins#web-style
items.desc: Web appearance suite with a 7-theme gallery (each a full 122-token --dsw-* mapping) plus one-click switching persisted in settings, Material You wallpaper color extraction that generates a whole dynamic palette, and a global corner-radius control. Themes ride on the official look system as override layers instead of fighting it, so the official light/dark/auto row stays valid.

items.name: dsh-theme-endfield
items.desc: Arknights: Endfield industrial-editorial theme for the DSH Web UI: cream paper, ink text, zero border radius, two switchable accent palettes (signal yellow / teal-cyan), plus optional marching-squares contour background, ENDFIELD watermark and boot progress plate.

items.name: dsh-skin-asuka-p01
items.desc: Unofficial Asuka-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness with dual character illustrations, day and night city-dome backdrops, and five appearance settings covering mode, backdrop, character position, backdrop intensity, and character size.

items.name: dsh-wallpaper_share
items.desc: Syncs the wallpaper currently applied in Wallpaper Engine to the DSH Web UI background through a local bridge: preview/capture/full render modes, monitor lock, a wallpaper library panel for local and market content, focus lens with eye tracking, immersive mode, and a Windows app launcher that installs software from direct links or a cloud-drive share link and starts it with one click.

items.name: dafy-whale-theme
items.desc: Ocean-blue theme for the DSH web interface: swimming fish, rising bubbles, a daily-quote ticker above the input box, and a replacement brand area; Settings → Marine Theme exposes 7 groups and 32 options (brand text and size, badge, primary color, watermark, fish, quotes, overall scale) that apply instantly without a reload, plus a two-step reset to defaults.

items.name: dsh-acrylic-light
items.desc: Windows Acrylic window material plus layered frosted panels for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, with a liquid-glass composer whose opacity slider runs from fully transparent to fully opaque. The window material needs a one-time app.asar patch via apply-when-closed.ps1; installing the plugin alone only styles the page.

items.name: dsh-use-wallpaper
items.desc: Renders Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers in real time in the browser (three.js player plus a Rust/WASM CPU particle simulation) and plays video and web wallpapers, falling back to the preview image, with no Wallpaper Engine runtime required. Scans the local Steam workshop library (431960) by auto-detection or a manual path, and offers a settings panel for wallpaper selection, library and engine directories, glow, pause and quality.

items.name: sakura-afternoon-skin
items.desc: Sakura-afternoon pastel skin for the DSH Web UI: light and dark sakura token palettes, a click-through falling-petal overlay with a soft vignette, a header petal toggle and a General-settings master switch.

items.name: dsh-pixel-ui
items.desc: Four-palette pixel-art skin for DSH Web (wood, parchment, warm, terminal green) with a bundled CJK pixel font served by the plugin's own host route, and a flat, shadow-free look.

items.name: dsh-codex-appearance
items.desc: Adds appearance settings with blue-gray, light and dark themes for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-open-meadow
items.desc: A coastal theme for official macOS DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2, with animated clouds, local waves, swaying foreground plants and Chinese settings.

items.name: dsh-theme-whalegirl
items.desc: Whale Girl light theme for the DSH Web UI, ported from a DreamSkin skin package: registers one native runtime theme with a full --dsw-* token remap derived from the source palette, layers the artwork as an ambient fixed wallpaper behind a frosted UI, and pins the theme against appearance-preference resets.

items.name: pixel-skin
items.desc: Pokémon-style skin for DSH Web with GBA frames, HP-bar status, effort level panel, and customizable color palettes.

items.name: dsh-claude-desktop-theme
items.desc: Claude Code Desktop-style theme for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with compact sidebar and chat layouts, light and dark themes, model and reasoning-effort controls, and an interactive pixel whale with spout, hop and tail-wag reactions on new sessions.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-paopaocat
items.desc: Fantasy glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web UI: a moonlit nether-forest scene with drifting teal clouds, red spider lilies spreading from the lower-left and a sleeping cat in the corner, drawn over a WebGL2 fluid background with its own wallpaper and video backgrounds. Ships two switchable variants (pale / saturated blue), plus cat-paw, fish, bubble and starlight decorations. One switch restores the stock interface exactly.

items.name: dsh-vscode-themes2
items.desc: Browse, search, install, and apply VS Code color themes to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: bundles 14 curated themes with live color-swatch previews, searches the official VS Code Marketplace for more, and one-click installs map any theme's palette onto the DSW design tokens with live switching and persisted selection.
